clips.title: The story
paras: Tormus Deepforge is a dwarven smith working at the center of the Great Forge in Ironforge. A dependable craftsman, he coordinates iron deliveries and supplies armaments for Alliance defense efforts across Khaz Modan and beyond.

Positioned right beside the roaring fires of the Great Forge, Tormus Deepforge oversees substantial metalworking tasks on behalf of the Bronzebeard clan. Beyond hammering steel himself, Tormus mourns his mentor, Sturgy Ironband, whose smithing compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh was overrun by Dark Iron dwarves after a load of strange umbral ore arrived there.
